en: So you're going to take on the Pokémon League. Not before you've dealt with me.
I've been thinking about what that dragon tamer said. I'm not saying he was right. But I'm not the same as I was.
...I lost. Again. But it doesn't feel the way it used to.
My Pokémon fought for me today. Not because I told them to. I couldn't have done that before.
Go on, then. Go and take the League. I'm going to train somewhere nobody bothers me, and when I come back I'll be stronger than all of you.
What are you waiting for? The League's that way.
